metadata.scenario: A tenant calls to dispute charges for unexpected maintenance fees in their monthly bill. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Karen Lewis. I'm calling because I have some questions about unexpected charges on my bill. I'm sorry to hear that, Karen. Let me help you with that. What specific charges are you concerned about? It seems there's a maintenance fee that I wasn't informed about. It’s quite high, and I don’t understand why it’s there. I understand your concern. Let me pull up your account details. Can you please confirm your address? Sure, it's 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205, Wichita, KS 67205. Thank you for that information, Karen. I’ll check your billing history right now. Please hold on for a moment. Okay, thanks. I see here that the maintenance fee is related to some additional services we provided last month. Did you receive notification about these services? No, I didn't receive anything. I was expecting just the regular charges. I apologize for the oversight, Karen. It’s important that we keep our clients informed. I will look into why this notice wasn’t sent. Thank you. I just want to ensure that I'm not being overcharged for services I didn't agree to. Absolutely, that’s completely fair. I’ll investigate and get back to you with a resolution. I appreciate that. And I’m also interested in post-operative care for my husband after his cardiac surgery next month. We can certainly assist with that. We offer post-surgery recovery care, which includes specialized support for clients recovering from procedures like cardiac surgery. That sounds great. What does that cost? The price for post-surgery recovery care ranges from $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours of service. That seems reasonable. How do I go about scheduling that? I can help you schedule that. I’ll need to confirm your husband’s surgery date and recovery needs. His surgery is scheduled for next month, but I’ll have to confirm the exact date. That’s okay. Let’s set a time for a follow-up call once you have that information. Yes, please. And could you also provide me with details on the dispute regarding my bill? Of course. I’ll investigate the maintenance fee and follow up with you by the end of this week. Sounds good. Thank you for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome, Karen. Thank you for reaching out, and we’ll speak soon. Bye. Goodbye.
